    Ordinary traces of types E_7 and E_8 (Lemma A.6) #

    lem:e78-traces (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Write x, y for the closed paths along the long and medium arms; the short arm gives (x + y)² = 0, and x⁵ = y³ = 0. The word identities y² = -yx - xy - x², yxy = xyx + x³, yx²y = -yx³ - xyx² - x²yx - x³y - 2x⁴ and F = yx³yx + yx⁴y + xyx³y - x²yx³ - x³yx² = 0 reduce cyclic words by their gaps (the numbers of x's between successive y's): "If a gap has length zero, one or two, apply the corresponding one of the first three identities. Each resulting term has fewer y's." The remaining words are cyclic words in a = yx³, b = yx⁴, and the relations [a²W] = 0, [abW] = -[baW], [b^q] = 0 dispose of them.

    With two invertible only degrees three, five and nine survive (part (2)); we record the vanishing in all other word degrees, which is what the period exclusion uses. A word y x^{g₁} ⋯ y x^{g_k} is blk [g₁, …, g_k]; the induction runs on the number k of y's, in a fixed word degree.
